name: Volkodlak
subtitle: Winter's Howl
description: Cast Despair and Inflict Savage Wounds on your Foes from the Shadows.
lore: The werewolves of Vyraj, volkodlak are either sorcerers and witches who have adopted monstrous form, or the victims of curses cast by such occultists. The resulting half-lupine being is savage and bestial, but cunning and clever, able to scheme, to trap, and to lure. They possess supernatural abilities beyond the obvious ferocity and strength, making them highly dangerous and unpredictable
divinity_generator: Gain [40] Divinity when placing a [Debuff] on an enemy.
